name: voicemail
label: Voicemail

modes.title: Cannot listen to messages
modes.symptom: customers unable to play back their stored messages
customer_says: I can't get into my voicemail. I dial it and it rings and rings and then cuts off.
My phone says I've got new voicemails, but when I call to listen there's just silence.
The voicemail service won't play my messages. It says please try again later every single time.
I've got messages waiting and no way of hearing them. The voicemail number just hangs up on me.

causes.cause: a failed storage array behind the voicemail platform
fixes: bringing the standby storage array into service

causes.cause: a broken trunk between the voice core and the voicemail platform
fixes: re-routing voicemail calls over a second trunk

workarounds: listen to messages through the visual voicemail screen in the Meridian app
ask callers to send a text instead of leaving a message
aftercare: dial the voicemail number once to refresh the message list
delete old messages if the mailbox reports that it is full

modes.title: Callers cannot leave messages
modes.symptom: callers hearing an engaged tone instead of the voicemail greeting
customer_says: People tell me they can't leave me a message. They just get a busy tone when I don't pick up.
My voicemail isn't taking messages. Callers say it never reaches the greeting.
When I miss a call it doesn't go to voicemail any more. It just rings out and ends.
My clients say my answerphone has stopped working. They can't leave anything.

causes.cause: a call divert rule deleted during a platform migration
fixes: restoring the deleted call divert rule

causes.cause: a recording service that ran out of free ports
fixes: adding ports to the recording service

causes.cause: a mailbox database locked by a failed backup job
fixes: releasing the lock left by the failed backup job

workarounds: set a temporary divert to another number for missed calls
switch on missed call text alerts from the phone's keypad menu
aftercare: ring the mobile from another phone to confirm the greeting plays
remove any temporary divert that was set up

modes.title: No new message alerts
modes.symptom: new message alerts not reaching handsets
customer_says: I'm not getting told when I have a voicemail. I only find out if I ring in and check.
The voicemail icon never appears any more. I found three old messages by accident.
My phone doesn't alert me to new voicemails. No text, no icon, nothing.
I've missed important messages because nothing tells me that they are there.

causes.cause: a stalled notification queue on the alert server
an alert template rejected by the message centre
a sync fault between the mailbox platform and the alert server
fixes: resyncing the mailbox platform with the alert server

workarounds: call the voicemail number twice a day to check for messages
turn on voicemail-to-email forwarding in the account settings
aftercare: expect a batch of late alerts for messages that are already stored
switch off email forwarding if it is no longer needed

modes.title: Greetings and PINs reset
modes.symptom: personal greetings replaced by the standard greeting
customer_says: My voicemail greeting has gone back to the robot voice. I recorded my own for the business.
Callers are hearing the default greeting instead of mine, and it won't accept my PIN to change it.
My personal greeting has disappeared, and the voicemail is asking me to set everything up from scratch.
The voicemail has forgotten my greeting and my PIN. It is treating me like a brand new customer.

causes.cause: a profile table overwritten during a database restore
fixes: restoring the profile table from the last good backup

causes.cause: a settings sync job that ran against the wrong region
a schema change that hid customers' saved preferences
fixes: applying a corrected schema to the preferences store

workarounds: record a short temporary greeting from the voicemail menu
use the default PIN shown in the account settings until profiles are restored
aftercare: check that the personal greeting plays when the mailbox is called
choose a new PIN if the default one was used

wrong_customer_side: a mailbox that has reached its message limit
voicemail switched off by a divert code dialled by mistake
a PIN entered wrongly too many times
an old handset that does not support visual voicemail
wrong_provider_side: the yearly clear-out of old voicemail messages
a mast fault in the area
an upgrade to a new voicemail system
a number change on the account that has not finished
